data.long_meaning: Bishnu is a name derived from the Sanskrit language and represents the Hindu deity, Lord Vishnu. He is the preserver of the universe and the savior of all beings. The name Bishnu is a reverence for his divine presence and power. The name Bishnu carries the meaning “Lord Vishnu” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bishnu usually hope their child will grow to embody lord vishnu and live with faith, good character and purpose.
